label: Foreign workers (ЗТМТМ, the act behind "u0417u0427u0420u0411") — status, not news
text: No quota or migration act appears in ДР or in the bills feed: the last published text remains МТСП's ЗИД на ЗТМТМ (consultation 12064-K, 8–22 January 2026), which lifts the third-country ceilings by 5 percentage points — to 25% of a firm's average headcount, 40% for SMEs — and is meant to close Commission infringement procedure № 2023/2017 on the seasonal-workers Directive 2014/36/EU.
